parameters.query:
select
  ci.content_id,
  ci.title,
  ci.status,
  p.caption_final,
  p.hashtags_final
from content_items ci
join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
where p.publish_status = 'draft'
order by ci.updated_at asc
limit 1;

delete from assets
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
  and asset_role = '{{$json.asset_role_sql}}';

insert into assets (
  content_id,
  scene_number,
  asset_role,
  provider,
  source_url,
  storage_url,
  mime_type,
  width,
  height,
  status
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  null,
  '{{$json.asset_role_sql}}',
  '{{$json.provider_sql}}',
  '{{$json.source_url_sql}}',
  '{{$json.storage_url_sql}}',
  '{{$json.mime_type_sql}}',
  {{$json.width}},
  {{$json.height}},
  '{{$json.status_sql}}'
)
returning content_id, asset_role, storage_url, status;

update content_items
set status = 'assets_ready',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;
